messages.subject: mac compile error - affxparser
parts:

Since the upgrade to R 2.5, I cannot get affxparser to compile on the
mac. Any suggestions? Is there something that has changed (or needs
to change with it)?

Below is the installation output ... it jumps around from arch=ppc and
arch=i386 ... is that normal?

Thanks,
Mark

Hi Mark,

Kasper is the one that might help out. He only reads the
aroma.affymetrix list once in a while, so I would suggest that you
send this to the Bioconductor list instead. There, he and others will
be able to help you faster.

Cheers

Henrik

messages.subject: Re: mac compile error - affxparser
parts:
Hi Mark

You may or may not be aware that the compiler suite etc changed from
R-2.4.x to R-2.5.0. You need Xcode 2.4.1 (from Apples website) and you
need to make sure you are using GCC 4 by doing a
# gcc_select
at the command line (you can use gcc_select to change compiler from
version 3 to 4).

You also need the fortran compiler fra CRAN - when you install the dmg
image of R from CRAN you need to click "customize" and choose the
fortran compiler.

If you need to clean out your old installation (recommended) you can
do it by
# sudo rm -R /usr/local/gcc4.0

Kasper

> aroma.affymetrix list once in a while, so I would suggest that you
> send this to the Bioconductor list instead. There, he and others will
> be able to help you faster.
>
> Cheers
>
> Henrik

messages.author: 41ed89aa70b5d27c
messages.subject: Re: mac compile error - affxparser
parts:
Hi Mark

This is an old problem you had: getting it to work on your Mac. I
assume that you are using a PPC Mac and the error has indeed something
to do with the fact that the compiler is jumping around between
arch=ppc and arch=i386. In fact I have the same problem on my
laptop... The issue is related to the fact that R-2.5.0 compiles
universal binaries of all packages as opposed to R.2.4.x that just
compiled a version for you specific architecture.

In fact it will not work on any PPC mac whether or not you comile it
from source or whether you download the binary from Bioconductor.
Using a version of affxparser for R-2.4.x should work fine, unless
there has been bug fixes.

Having said all of that I need to do some magic with autoconfigure to
get it to work. And I do not have time for that right now. I will of
course get back once the bug is fixed, but it might (will) take 2
weeks or so.

Kasper
